# Kinetix Scholar
> https://kinetix-scholar.vercel.app/

## Summary

Kinetix Scholar is a free, no-login, no-backend research hub for students,
academics, and independent researchers. It provides curated directories of
real AI-assisted research tools, direct links to official publisher LaTeX
and Word templates, copy-ready academic writing prompts, an interactive
Boolean/PICO search-string builder, and a research lifecycle workflow guide.

No registration required. No data is collected. All tool links point to
third-party services; Kinetix Scholar does not host or operate any of them.

---

## Routes

### / — Homepage
Overview of the site, featured tools, goal-based tool recommendations
(original paper, systematic review, PhD thesis, patent, book chapter),
and a rotating Scientific Discovery Chronicle panel.

### /ai-research-tools — AI Research Tools Directory
A curated, hand-written directory of real research tools organised into
12 categories: Literature Discovery, Literature Mapping, Systematic Review,
PDF & Paper Analysis, Academic Writing, Thesis & Patents, Citations &
References, Data & Statistics, Coding & ML, Visualization & Diagrams,
Journal & Conference Finders, and Datasets & Repositories.
Includes keyword search, category filter, usage-ranked sorting
(localStorage), and bookmark/save functionality.

### /academic-templates — Academic Templates Hub
Direct links to official Overleaf and publisher download pages for
peer-reviewed manuscript templates: IEEE Conference (IEEEtran), IEEE
Transactions, ACM Primary Article, Springer Nature (sn-jnl), Springer LNCS,
Elsevier CAS, PRISMA 2020 Systematic Review, ACM Computing Surveys /
IEEE COMST Comprehensive Survey, General Narrative Review, Springer Book
Chapter (svmult), Elsevier Book Chapter, Universal PhD/Masters Thesis, and
USPTO/WIPO Patent Specification. Each entry lists the publisher, format
badges, and the required manuscript sections.

### /academic-prompt-vault — Academic Prompt Vault
Copy-ready prompt templates for use with any AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude,
Perplexity, Google NotebookLM, etc.). Organised across six workflow stages:
(1) Topic & Free Dataset Finder, (2) Gap & Literature Synthesis,
(3) Experiment & Code Generation, (4) Section-by-Section Paper Drafting,
(5) Paraphrasing & Source Synthesis, (6) Reviewer Response & Polish.
Prompts include fill-in placeholders (domain, venue, level). Users supply
their own AI tool; Kinetix Scholar does not operate any AI service.

### /research-lab-pico-builder — Research Lab & PICO Builder
Two interactive utilities:
- Boolean/PICO Query Synthesizer: generates formatted search strings for
  Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, and Google Scholar from user-supplied
  Population, Intervention, Outcome, and Exclusion terms with a year range.
- Pre-Submission Manuscript Readiness Auditor: a 12-item checklist
  (title/abstract quality, citation lineage, statistical rigour, figures,
  open-science statements, formatting) with a live readiness score stored
  in localStorage.
Also includes a Research Stack Architect panel with four preset pipelines
(Q1 Empirical Paper, PRISMA Systematic Review, PhD Dissertation, Patent
Filing) showing recommended tools and their roles at each stage.

### /research-lifecycle-workflow — Research Lifecycle Workflow
A nine-stage annotated guide to the full academic research lifecycle:
(01) Idea & Prior Art, (02) Literature Search, (03) Systematic Review,
(04) Research Gap & Question, (05) Methodology & Power, (06) Experiments
& Code, (07) Data Analysis & Plots, (08) Manuscript & LaTeX Writing,
(09) Journal Selection & Publication. Each stage names the recommended
free tools from the directory.

---

## What this site is not

- Not an AI service. No language model runs on this site.
- Not a plagiarism checker or AI-detection bypass tool.
- Not affiliated with IEEE, Springer, Elsevier, ACM, or any publisher.
- Not a data broker. No accounts, no tracking beyond anonymous localStorage.
